name: ltr_license_scraper_portland
what_it_holds: Python 3.11+ scraper (requests + pandas) that downloads Portland, MAINE's Long-Term Rental (not short-term) landlord license list since Jan 1 2022 from the city website, saving a CSV with a JSON detail column per license; GPL-3.0, archived/read-only as of 13 Aug 2026.
why_useful: Wrong city (Portland, Maine, not Portland, Oregon) and wrong rental type (LTR landlord licensing, not STR) — flagged only as a reusable scraper template for building an equivalent one against Portland, Oregon's ASTR permit registry or another city's licence portal that lacks a Socrata API.
geography: Portland, Maine (template transferable to Portland, OR or other non-Socrata city license sites)
duplicate_of_holding: no overlap; not STR, not one of the target cities

name: Niteowlpt/conforme-pt-toolkit
what_it_holds: Apache-2.0 Python toolkit implementing Portuguese short-term-rental regulatory compliance logic: RNAL, SIBA (Lei 23/2007) guest-reporting, AT Modelo 30 tax form, and municipal tourist-tax arithmetic. No committed registry data; encodes the rules/fields RNAL registrations must carry.
why_useful: No dataset, but documents the RNAL registration schema and municipal tourist-tax rules precisely enough to help interpret or reverse-engineer any future scrape of Portugal's national RNAL public register.
time_coverage: n/a (compliance code, not a time series)
themes: European STR registration and tourist-accommodation registries (Portugal RNAL, Spain tourist dwellings, Italy CIN, France meublés de tourisme, Amsterdam, Berlin, Vienna, Lisbon, Barcelona HUTB, Paris)
why_all: No dataset, but documents the RNAL registration schema and municipal tourist-tax rules precisely enough to help interpret or reverse-engineer any future scrape of Portugal's national RNAL public register.
